Frequently asked questions

Can you clean vacant units between tenants?

Yes. We do turnover cleaning with a fast turnaround so units are ready to show and rent.

Do you work with property managers?

Yes. We work directly with property managers and associations and can coordinate access and schedules with them.

Do you clean common-area carpets and floors?

Yes. Floor care is our specialty: carpet extraction, tile cleaning, stripping, waxing and burnishing.

Service area: about 25 miles around Lowell, MA
